quotes.text: PRIMARY SOURCE RECORD DOSSIER — Work Session (2021-12-17)

turns.text: want us to go ahead and start robin now that she's on yes that would be great mr president well welcome everybody to the uh city council work session for december uh today's subject will be the presentation of financial and compliance audit for the year ended june 30th 2021 so we tend to do this at this time every year i appreciate my colleagues uh joining us today it's pretty hectic with the two weeks to go in the year so i know it's pretty difficult to make time in your with that we will start off with our city treasurer robin lachman and you'll be starting off with some introductions oh i should say as is always the practice for this work session there will be no comments or questions taken from members of the uh but there will be uh comments or questions taken from members of the governing body with that robin i'll turn it over to you okay thank you good afternoon mr president members of the city council my name is robin lockman and i am your city treasurer the city is required by state statute to go undergo an audit each fiscal year by an independent certified public accounting firm additionally any non-federal entity such as the city that spends more than 750 thousand dollars in federal grant funds each year is also required to have what is called a single audit a single audit is a rigorous audit with the purpose of ensuring that the city as the recipient of federal funds is in compliance with the federal program's requirements on how money can be spent in fiscal year 2021 the city expanded nearly 8.3 million dollars in federal funds through programs such as the metropolitan planning organization transit cares act among many others to enhance the degree of confidence in the organization's financial statements a qualified auditor is engaged to examine these statements and give their professional opinion on whether they are barely stated in all material respects this in turn gives our citizens confidence in the management of their public funds as you can imagine the city's audit is a very time consuming process my department starts working with auditors in july of each year and the audit continues until the report is issued in december i would now like to introduce our speaker stephanie pickering whose partner at mhp who will be presenting the city's fiscal year audit 2021 to you she will provide a presentation that will last approximately 30 minutes and then answer any questions you may have and i'm also available for any questions i appreciate your time thank you thank you robin and and thank you for all the hard work that you and your staff do for us each and every day i know this is a really really time consuming process for you all um but you always do such a great job so
